title: Bruno Sammaciccia, the Nordics with underground bases, and the Contrari

tellings.quote: There's a case that I cover in Closer Encounters. this guy Bruno Samachicia and his associates um were engaged by these Nordics who had underground bases

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, describes on Jesse Michels' podcast a case from his book Closer Encounters. He says that in 1950s Italy a man named Bruno Sammaciccia and his friends were contacted by "Nordics", tall, human-looking beings who had bases underground, and who were said to be at odds with a rival group called the Contrari. If true, it would mean different non-human groups were living hidden on Earth and competing with each other.
